activities.caption: pair each anatomy part with what it does for the street
activities.name: udJacobsMatch

config.prompt: Jacobs's four load-bearing parts, plus the thread through all of them:

pairs.right: sidewalks used at different hours by different people
frequent corners, route choices, frontage per metre
cheap floorplate where new enterprises incubate
safety from continuous, informal, willing observation

config.why: The blank podium wall is not just ugly but criminogenic — and the shops-and-flats street outperforms the patrolled plaza.

activities.caption: bet first — towers in parking lots
activities.name: udDensityPredict

config.q: High-density estates built as towers in parking lots fail the street. What actually went wrong?
choices: No street frontage, no mixed use, no small blocks — a delivery-model failure, not a people-per-hectare failure
Towers are always too tall for sidewalk trust
config.why: Jacobs's density is fine-grained and mixed — brownstone streets at 40–80 dwellings per hectare are among the most loved urban fabrics on earth.

activities.anchor: one incremental street at a time
activities.caption: rebuild Gehl's ladder of public life
activities.name: udGehlOrder

config.prompt: People arrive in stages, each with a design prerequisite. Order them:
items: People walk — comfortably, along an active edge
Then stop — soft edges invite it: doors, niches, frontage at eye height
Then sit — sittable space: ledges, steps, movable chairs near the flow
Then linger — sun and shade through the day, and other people to watch
config.why: Each stage has a design prerequisite — and a facade with 15 doors and windows per 100 m outperforms a blank wall by every measure Gehl counted.

activities.anchor: what pedestrians would supposedly never do
activities.caption: call the magnitude — the Strøget's pilot
activities.name: udStrogetEstimate

config.prompt: Copenhagen closed the 1.1 km Strøget to cars as a pilot against shopkeepers' predictions of retail collapse. Roughly how many years was the pilot meant to run before being made permanent?
config.why: November 1962: a two-year pilot. Foot traffic rose instead, and Gehl's counting teams tracked fifty years of street-by-street extension.
config.context: The method as much as the result: a reversible, measurable, small first step — observed honestly — beat any amount of modelling.

activities.anchor: Choice, not distance, is what the designer supplies
activities.caption: true or false — Whyte's cameras
activities.name: udWhyteJudge

statements.s: People gravitate to where others already are — the front row, the sunny steps beside the crowd.
statements.why: Whyte's time-lapse films show the reverse of the retreat fantasy: emptiness is unattractive.

statements.s: Movable chairs outscore fixed ones because choice itself attracts.
statements.why: What people avoid is not company but imposition — benches without choice, sun without shade.

statements.s: Good public-space design isolates people so they can relax.
statements.why: Empty plazas stay empty precisely because emptiness is unattractive.

statements.s: Wind tunnels empty plazas no matter how they are paved.
statements.why: Sun and shade pattern use through the day — and wind empties what paving cannot fill.

activities.caption: file the inclusion moves — whose exclusion do they answer?
activities.name: udIncludeBuckets

config.prompt: Inclusion is geometry, pricing and programme. File each move:

items.label: tactile paving, seating every 100–150 m, level-boarding transit
transit and walkability deciding the share of income spent on mobility
Vienna's gender-mainstreaming pilots — lighting paths, auditing who uses which space
safety audits: lighting, sightlines, active frontage on walking routes

config.why: Designing for the excluded group improves the default for everyone — the neutral 'average user' is a fiction whose streets exclude nearly everyone else.

config.text: The counter-tools pull the sprawl lever in reverse: transit accessibility capitalises into %%0%% values, zoning reform legalises the %%1%% middle of small apartment buildings, and parking minimums turn out to be hidden %%2%% costs and induced driving.
config.hint: What follows the rails, what zoning legalises, and what parking requirements quietly tax.
